goal: Before the next scheduling change, produce eight independent verification reports covering: the gamma queue wait for gamma_preview, the delta queue wait for delta_preview, the remaining memory of the pool after admitting every READY pool job, the number of GPU waves to drain the gpu backlog, the effective timeout margin for t1, the worst-case retry backlog for r1, the initial dataset transfer seconds for the profiled link, the start slack for d1. The reports are read-only and must preserve all dependencies and event evidence.

runtime.scheduling_policy: A task is runnable only when all dependencies are terminal-success and its resource request fits the current free capacity.
